definitions: A software architecture or design pattern where the structure, validation rules, and rendering logic of user interface forms and their corresponding display components are dynamically generated or controlled by a predefined data schema (e.g., JSON Schema, XML Schema).
Systems that automatically create and manage user input forms and their visual representations based on a formal description of the data they are intended to collect or display.
examples: The development team implemented Schema-driven forms/renderers to ensure data consistency across all user input.
Using Schema-driven forms/renderers significantly reduced the time needed to build new data entry interfaces.
The platform's flexibility comes from its robust Schema-driven forms/renderers.
